children: Gloo Holdings, Inc. reported third-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue rising to $46.6M from $16.2M a year earlier while the company posted a net loss attributable to stockholders of $21.3M, or diluted loss per share of $(0.25), both improved versus the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $46.6M for Q3 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up from $16.2M in the year-ago quarter (188.0% YoY).
Net income: Net loss attributable to stockholders of $21.3M for Q3, versus net loss of $43.3M in the year-ago quarter (improved YoY).
Diluted EPS: Loss per share $(0.25) for Q3, versus $(6.45) in the year-ago quarter (improved YoY).
Revenue growth was driven by platform and platform solutions expansion, with total revenue up roughly 188% quarter-over-quarter and about 209% year-to-date.
Advertising and subscription channels expanded materially; advertising revenue increased by $7.3M for the quarter and $17.2M year-to-date.
Strategic acquisitions—including Westfall, EMD and Masterworks—broadened fundraising, technology, media and consulting capabilities.
Product and AI progress included the launch and scaling of Gloo 360 and integration of Applied AI to enhance customer workflows and agentic operations.
Operational restructuring actions were initiated to reduce headcount and vendor spend, with $4.4M of charges recorded to streamline costs and improve margins.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Gloo Holdings, Inc. 3Q 2026: Revenue $46.6M, EPS $(0.25) — 10-Q Summary
